name: dumbbell incline fly
description: An incline dumbbell fly that opens the arms in a wide arc to work the upper chest.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a comfortable angle and lie back with your feet planted.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your upper chest, palms facing each other and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides in a wide arc, keeping the same slight bend in your elbows.
Lower only as far as your shoulders comfortably allow, then bring the dumbbells back together over your chest along the same arc.
